items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I got him and Joe Thomas, who was Walter Thomas' brother, to come up from there to play with the Virginia Ravens.

ctx.x: Now, this is Joe Thomas the tenor player?
Not the one with Jimmy Lunceford. He was an alto player, Joe Thomas. He's here in New York now. He's a writer, he's with --

items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And, Eddie Barefield. [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I see. Yes.

ctx.x: The Virginia Ravens was a band back in the '20s.
Yes, I think Eddie Barefield told me about that.
Yes, a tremendous band. A fellow by the name of Eddie Mallory played in that band. And I think Doc Cheatham (?) played in that band but I'm not too sure.
